name: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power
description: Epic drama set thousands of years before the events of J.R.R. Tolkien's 'The Hobbit' and 'The Lord of the Rings' follows an ensemble cast of characters, both familiar and new, as they confront the long-feared re-emergence of evil ...

episodes.title: A Shadow of the Past
episodes.overview: Galadriel is disturbed by signs of an ancient evil’s return; Arondir makes an unsettling discovery; Elrond is presented with an intriguing new venture; Nori breaks the Harfoot community’s most deeply-held rule.

episodes.title: Adrift
episodes.overview: Galadriel finds a new ally; Elrond faces a cold reception from an old friend; Nori endeavors to help a Stranger; Arondir searches for answers while Bronwyn warns her people of a threat.

episodes.title: Adar
episodes.overview: Arondir finds himself a captive; Galadriel and Halbrand explore a legendary kingdom; Elendil is given a new assignment; Nori faces the consequences.

episodes.title: The Great Wave
episodes.overview: Queen Regent Míriel’s faith is tested; Isildur finds himself at a crossroads; Elrond uncovers a secret; Arondir is given an ultimatum; Theo disobeys Bronwyn.

episodes.title: Partings
episodes.overview: Nori questions her instincts; Elrond struggles to stay true to his oath; Halbrand weighs his destiny; The Southlanders brace for attack.

episodes.title: Udûn
episodes.overview: Adar and his army march on Ostirith.

episodes.title: The Eye
episodes.overview: Survivors of a cataclysm try to find safety; the Harfoots confront evil; Durin is torn between friendship and duty; Adar considers a new name.

episodes.title: Alloyed
episodes.overview: New alliances are forged.

episodes.title: Elven Kings Under the Sky
episodes.overview: Sauron bargains with Adar. The Stranger and Nori venture into new lands. The Three Elven Rings face judgment.

episodes.title: Where the Stars are Strange
episodes.overview: Darkness falls over Khazad-dûm. Sauron and Galadriel each seek new allies. The Stranger and Harfoots encounter a growing threat.

episodes.title: The Eagle and the Sceptre
episodes.overview: Isildur and an old friend reunite. Arondir grapples with change. Míriel faces rising opposition. Annatar counsels Celebrimbor.

episodes.title: Eldest
episodes.overview: The Stranger finds what he’s been searching for. Arondir and Isildur search for Theo. Galadriel and Elrond walk into a trap.

episodes.title: Halls of Stone
episodes.overview: When Durin grows suspicious of the Dwarven Rings, Celebrimbor must reassess his priorities. Amidst Númenor’s shifting currents, Elendil searches for hope.

episodes.title: Where Is He?
episodes.overview: Galadriel considers a proposition. Elendil faces judgment. The Stranger finds himself at a crossroads. Sauron’s plans bear fruit.

episodes.title: Doomed to Die
episodes.overview: Eregion’s fate is decided.

episodes.title: Shadow and Flame
episodes.overview: The free peoples of Middle-earth struggle against the forces of darkness.

episodes.title: Marnûkh
episodes.overview: War rages between the Elves and Sauron. Galadriel remembers a long-lost love. Durin welcomes home his brother… and another unexpected guest.

episodes.title: The Gift of Men
episodes.overview: Tumult grips Númenor. Theo is offered a new path. The Dwarves weigh their options. The Elves learn of Sauron's plan - and debate a perilous mission.

episodes.title: The Secret Fire
episodes.overview: Gandalf works to keep Rhûn out of the war. Elendil hunts a spy. Marnûkh leads Galadriel and Arondir to Gundabad as Sauron questions the orc's agenda.

episodes.title: Gundabad
episodes.overview: At Gundabad, our heroes find less than they came for and more than they expected. Elrond brings Gil-galad an urgent mission. Durin defends his throne.

episodes.title: The Lady of Lórien
episodes.overview: Galadriel catches up with a lost love; Sauron catches up to her. Elrond & Gil-galad reach Númenor. Gandalf seeks peace but gets a little carried away.

episodes.title: From Valinor
episodes.overview: Galadriel finds unexpected help. Sauron presses his advantage. Númenor's tensions spark a surprising proposal. Thrain grows ruthless in his pursuit.

episodes.title: Stories from the Legendarium Featurette
episodes.overview: Every good quest needs a fellowship. Join the excitement as Patrick McKay, JD Payne, Morfydd Clark and Ismael Cruz Córdova reveal what to expect in The Lord of the Rings: The Rings Of Power.

episodes.title: Stories of the Second Age – Lindon
episodes.overview: Enter the capital of the High Elves and learn from cast how these immortal beings deal with the rising evil in Middle-earth.

episodes.title: Stories of the Second Age – Númenor
episodes.overview: Cast explore the breathtaking island kingdom of Númenor and share background on a society at the height of its power.

episodes.title: Stories of the Second Age – The Southlands
episodes.overview: Paying the price for decisions made generations ago, The Southlanders must now face a new evil might on lurking on their horizon.

episodes.title: Stories of the Second Age – Rhovanion
episodes.overview: Cast provide a behind-the-scenes glimpse at the Harfoots, a mysterious band of early hobbits hidden from sight until now.

episodes.title: Stories of the Second Age – Khazad-dûm
episodes.overview: Learn about the secretive realm of the dwarves as cast discuss what mysteries might lie beneath the Misty Mountains.

episodes.overview: Go behind-the-scenes of The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power, season 1 and see how this epic world was brought to life.
